notice.documentationStatement: This is a documentation profile, not a recommendation: every cell states what a specification or an operator's own documentation says, no number in this document was produced by executing a payment, no rail is endorsed, no ordering implies a best buy, and no rail is being suggested for use.
notice.evenHandedStatement: The same twelve questions were put to all six rails, in the same fixed order, against each rail's own primary documentation, on a single date (2026-10-09).

feeQuotation.evenHandedStatement: Every rail's fee facts are quoted from that rail's own published fee documentation, retrieved on the same date by the same procedure.
feeQuotation.quotationStatement: These fee facts are a quotation of published fee documentation, not a recommendation: no rail is endorsed, no ordering implies a best buy, and no rail is being suggested for use.
feeQuotation.sourceStatement: Each fee fact is quoted from the rail's own published fee documentation at the source URL given beside it, retrieved on 2026-10-09.

notice.fixedOrderingStatement: Rails are listed alphabetically by rail name. That ordering is fixed and carries no performance meaning.
notice.sourcesStatement: Every documentation-derived cell cites the primary source it rests on, by URL, with the date it was retrieved.
